msg: PyQt5 import: PyQt5 is GPL v3 unless you hold a Riverbank commercial licence (670 USD per developer), and it runs on Qt 5.15, whose standard support ended 2025-05-26.
PyQt6 import: PyQt6 is GPL v3 unless you hold a Riverbank commercial licence (670 USD per developer). A closed-source app that ships it under GPL must publish its source.
pyqtSignal does not exist in PySide6.
pyqtSlot does not exist in PySide6.
pyqtProperty does not exist in PySide6.
uic.loadUi / uic.loadUiType is PyQt-only; PySide6 has no uic module.
fix: QUiLoader().load(path) from PySide6.QtUiTools, or compile with pyside6-uic

msg: sip is PyQt's binding layer; PySide6 uses shiboken6.
QVariant is not exposed in PySide6; values are plain Python objects.
fix: pass the Python value directly (None, int, str, dict)

msg: QRegExp was removed in Qt 6, so PySide6 has no QRegExp.
QDesktopWidget and QApplication.desktop() were removed in Qt 6.
QAction moved from QtWidgets to QtGui in Qt 6.
exec_() is the Python 2 era alias; PySide6 deprecates it.
